name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, ow, ow, ow……」

name: Momiji
message: 「You okay?」
Setsugekka walks over slowly, holding her lower back.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「'Okay'? How could I possibly be okay? You beat the living daylights out of me, you jerk！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You could’ve held back a little!」

name: Momiji
message: 「You were the one who told me to come at you with no holding back, weren’t you?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Did I？ Well, I forgot all about that！」

name: Momiji
message: 「How convenient your brain is.」
I walk slowly alongside Setsugekka, who has finally caught up to me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaah, Momimomi really is strong, huh.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, yeah.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「At this rate, there’s no way I can win, huh? What a pain.」
I’ve practiced sparring matches against Setsugekka many times now.
My record is 23 wins and zero losses. In fact, Setsugekka hasn’t even landed a single hit on me.

name: Momiji
message: 「Why don't you just give up already？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Are you stupid? If I did that, I wouldn't even know why I came to this academy anymore!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m going to beat Suzakuin no matter what！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Geez, what’s so fun about that?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, win or lose, Jindou is fun. Just doing it is enjoyable, you know~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Is that right? Then it doesn't really matter if you can't beat me, does it?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s a completely different story.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The Setsugekka in me finds Jindou fun just for the sake of it, but the Kazamine in me has to beat Suzakuin.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, I might not look it, but I’m a complicated person.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don’t think you’re as complicated as you say. I’m the same way, after all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「The Suzakuin in me has to become Toujinegi no matter what, but personally, I don’t really feel that way at all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then why do you do Jindou, Momimomi, personally speaking？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh？ Um... I wonder why.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You don't even know?!」
Now that she mentions it, I realize.
Ever since I was born, as a Suzakuin, I've been expected to win in Jindou as a matter of course.
Because of that, I never really thought about what I myself wanted to do.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I'll find something eventually.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Not being able to beat someone who practices Jindou with such a half-hearted attitude... This world really is unfair!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't call it half-hearted.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yowch... Ow, ow, it's not just my back, my butt hurts too...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Are you okay？ Want to lean on my shoulder？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph! As if a Kazamine could ever lean on a Suzakuin's shoulder!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, yeah, if you say so.」
Honestly, she's so stubborn.
—Just then, a few female academy students came walking toward us.

name: Female Student A
message: 「Ah...？！ H-Hello there...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hello.」

name: Female Student A
message: 「Well then, please excuse me...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes, good day.」
I see them off with a bright smile.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Phew, time for a little break...」
Setsugekka comes to a halt, lightly tapping her lower back.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That girl just now—someone you know, Momimomi？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, well, an old acquaintance.」
I can hear the voices of the girls walking away.

name: Female Student B
message: 「Hey, hey, that was her just now, right—one of the Suzakuins? You know her?」

name: Female Student A
message: 「H-Hey, keep your voice down...！ I just used to practice at the same dojo with her in the past, that's all.」

name: Female Student B
message: 「Whoa, so you're from the same school？ That's awesome！ Introduce me next time—I've been wanting to talk to her.」

name: Female Student A
message: 「...You'd better not get too involved with her.」

name: Female Student B
message: 「Huh? Why?」

name: Female Student A
message: 「I mean, she's just way too strong. She's on a completely different level—it's totally demoralizing, and just being around her would break your spirit.」

name: Female Student B
message: 「Really？ Isn't she a first-year just like us, though？」

name: Female Student A
message: 「We used to go to the same dojo back in elementary school, and even back then she was already stronger than the head instructor.」

name: Female Student B
message: 「Yikes, what the heck... Isn't she a monster？」

name: Female Student A
message: 「Yeah, the Suzakuin bloodline is pure thoroughbred. Ordinary people have nothing to gain by getting close to them.」

name: Female Student B
message: 「More importantly, who was that girl next to her again？」

name: Female Student A
message: 「Oh, I feel like I've seen her somewhere before, too. ...Oh, I remember! That's it—she's from the Kazamine family.」

name: Female Student B
message: 「Oh right, the Kazamine Group！」
Their voices gradually grew more distant. Still, because they were talking so loudly, every word carried straight over to us.

name: Female Student B
message: 「Still, I wonder why a Kazamine is hanging out with a Suzakuin.」

name: Female Student A
message: 「Well, you know, probably trying to curry favor with them. I mean, they're merchants at heart, right？」

name: Female Student B
message: 「Oh, maybe that's it. If they can't rise on actual skill, they should just give up being a martial family and stick to business... Hehe.」
After that, they walked off into the distance, still chatting away happily about something or other.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, Momimomi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「W-What？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What are you planning to have for dinner tonight？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I haven't really decided yet, though.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, I see. Okay, I'll come over later, then.」
I wonder if Setsugekka didn't hear that conversation just now.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Aww man, you've got it so good, Momimomi！」

name: Momiji
message: 「About what？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Just thinking how the difference between the Suzakuins and the Kazamines really shows at times like this.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So you really did hear them.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course I heard them when they were talking that loudly.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Does it bother you？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, I'd be lying if I said it didn't.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In fact, it's because the public thinks of us like that that Kei-chan's working so hard to lift up the Kazamine name.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still, I guess it can't be helped. Truth is, Kazamine hasn't had any strong swordsmen up until now.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Which is exactly why this year, I'm gonna wiiin！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Once I win the Martial Festival and become Toujinegi, they'll be way too embarrassed to say stuff like that anymore.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph, they can go ahead and borrow all the sore-loser whining they want in advance while they still can.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Once I make it big, they can suffer under all that debt!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Pfft, ahahaha!」
I couldn't help bursting out laughing at Setsugekka's endless positivity.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wh-What are you laughing at？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Nothing, I just thought that's really great. You're the best, Secchan.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, you're making fun of me again, aren't you!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Not at all. I genuinely envy you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh~ Are you really sure about that~」
I stepped up beside Setsugekka and draped her arm around my neck.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wh-What are you doing？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Your back hurts, doesn't it? Stop acting tough and come on, let's go.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, yeah... thanks.」
And so, feeling Setsugekka's weight on my shoulder.
We leaned close against each other and headed for the dorms.
